topic: Why The Narrator Has No Name
description:
Notice how in Fight Club, Edward Norton’s character never actually has a name? Throughout the entire movie, nobody ever calls him by his real name.

In this episode of Cinema X-Ray, we dissect Fight Club and uncover Why The Narrator Has No Name. Beyond the surface plot lies a masterclass in visual storytelling and character psychology.
